Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth:

Summary of ask:
- Evaluate Redwood inference for a customer-facing fraud-explainability feature (low-latency generation + reranking).
- Key constraints: no persistent customer-identifying data in logs, SOC2 evidence required, and tight latency targets for p50.

Proposed POC scope & success criteria (attached: POC-success-criteria.xlsx):
- Env: Dedicated VPC deployment with limited retention (14 days).
- Duration: 2 weeks of active evaluation (see timeline below).
- Success metrics: latency p50 < 300ms, throughput ~50 qps, rerank accuracy > 92% on your labeled set, and zero data egress outside requested VPC.

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Kickoff: week of Mar 8 (proposed Mon Mar 9).
- FinTechCo to provide sample dataset + IP allowlist by Wed Mar 11.
- Redwood ingest + test environment readiness by Fri Mar 13.
- Evaluation run: Mon Mar 15 - Fri Mar 19.
- Wrap & review: Mon Mar 22.

Ownership:
- Customer POC owner: Tom Reynolds (FinTechCo).
- Redwood SE: Dev Patel (cc'd).
- Redwood CS lead: Lauren Bishop (cc'd) for success/runbook.

Blockers / risk register (high-level):
1) Data egress concerns — mitigation: dedicated VPC, VPC peering, KMS-managed keys.
2) Tokenization/format mismatch with your pre-processing pipeline — mitigation: pre-tokenize or shared preproc script; SE to validate during ingest.

Next steps (action items):
- Asha/Tom: confirm success criteria above and attach sample dataset S3 path + security questionnaire answers by Wed Mar 11.
- Dev: confirm infra tasks and dependencies for dedicated environment.
- Lauren: confirm runbook and support cadence.

Attachments: POC-success-criteria.xlsx, Network-Reqs.pdf

Thanks — I can set up the kickoff calendar once we confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan and success criteria - Redwood + FinTechCo (technical notes)

Folks — quick tech notes for the POC requirements Asha raised:

1) Network / data egress: we can provision a dedicated private deployment (VPC) in the FinTechCo AWS account via VPC peering + Transit Gateway, or host in our account with strict egress ACLs. Prefer the customer-hosted VPC peering for maximum assurance. We'll need the following from FinTechCo:
   - IP allowlist (CIDR blocks)
   - S3 role or presigned URLs for data ingestion
   - KMS key ARN if they want customer-managed encryption

2) Logging & retention: can configure to redact PII and set retention to 14 days. Audit logs can be provided via a secure bucket pull for SOC2 review.

3) Tokenization mismatch (potential blocker): sometimes clients pre-tokenize whitespace/escaping differently which breaks the model input. Workarounds:
   - Option A: FinTechCo pre-tokenizes using our provided tokenization script (we can push a small python script).
   - Option B: We run a lightweight pre-tokenization step in ingestion and log mismatches; this adds ~10-20ms overhead but keeps the client pipeline untouched.

I'll prepare a short checklist for required artifacts and a runbook stub. Attaching draft Network-Reqs.pdf for reference.

-Dev
Senior SE, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks for the quick reply and the security questionnaire. Asha: we'll provide SOC2 artifacts (overview + available audit logs) and a named contact for more detailed evidence — I'll share that in the next 24 hours.

Regarding S3 access: we support both presigned URLs and an ingestion role. Presigned URLs are simplest for a short trial; if you prefer role-based access we can coordinate IAM permissions. Please let us know which you prefer and share the S3 path by EOD Wed Mar 11.

Confirming the POC success criteria to be used for acceptance testing:
- Latency: p50 < 300ms on your representative prompt set.
- Accuracy: rerank precision@3 >= 92% on your labeled eval set.
- Stability: zero unexplained errors during evaluation window.
- Security: no unencrypted egress; retention <= 14 days.

Timeline (updated):
- Kickoff: Tue Mar 9, 10:00am PT — I'll send the calendar invite.
- Data ingestion deadline: Thu Mar 12 (moving one day to allow for procurement items).
- Evaluation run: Mon Mar 15 - Fri Mar 19.
- Final review: Mon Mar 22.

Risk register (top 3):
- R1: Tokenization mismatch causing runtime errors — Mitigation: Dev will provide tokenization script + optional pre-tokenize step. Escalation: SE manager Sean Gallagher (cc'd) if we hit a blocker.
- R2: Procurement/NDA delay impacting kickoff — Mitigation: provide trial license + paused billing; Marissa to coordinate with procurement.
- R3: Network config delays for VPC peering — Mitigation: we can run in our sandbox with strict egress rules if peering isn't ready.

Attachments: POC-runbook.md (draft)

If that all looks good I'll kick off the calendar and open a HubSpot deal record for the POC.

Best,
Marissa
